pr_body:
##### Summary
If ACLK fails to connect report it in case telemetry is enabled (e.g. respect DO_NOT_TRACK of course)

We send up to last 10 events of LWS to the GA to be able to analyse at what point connection failed.

Fixes #8051 

##### Component Name
ACLK
##### Test Plan
Fail connection in different ways. Look at the reports in Google Analytics

Example of event data when connection failed on certificate verification: "30,1,58,19,29"

##### Additional Information
pr_comments:
Manage this branch in Squash

Test this branch here: https://underhoodreport-aclk-failures-tfvs5.squash.io

It does report on connection failures
Example:
```
Could not connect MQTT over WSS server "dev.private.netdata.cloud:443". LwsReason:"HS: ws upgrade response not 101
```

will report 

`'ACLK_CONN_FAIL' 'FAIL' '30,45,1,24,58,58,58,19,29'`

Yes i decided to log callbacks instead of handpicking simulated situations (my original plan). This way we should have reports for all cases and we can look at the callbacks to analyse (this is what we do anyway when we debug)

issue_context.title: Report cases where the Agent Cloud link is blocked by firewall
issue_context.body:
#### Discussion for the planning meeting on Wednesday

* This needs to be groomed before we can estimate the complexity.
* If this is needed by March 25 then this causes a problem in how it can be placed in the upcoming sprint.

#### Summary

Ensure that the requirements of product#243 are met.

- [x] Define endpoint for ACLK connection failures with SRE team if not done by #8050 already. Endpoint will be GAnalytics
- [x] Implement reporting to the endpoint of cases like:
    - SSL update failed
    - WebSockets update failed
- [x] do not send anything if `DO_NOT_TRACK` env var is set
comments:
Please groom in the upcoming sprint how we will do this.
* Where should the reports be sent to?
* How should the reports be sent?
* If this is google analytics then what will be the event types and other fields?
* If this is google analytics then will we be doing this through an external script?
* Do we receive any notifications that the report was sent successfully - should it be retried?

- **Where:** Google Analytics
- **How:** Call the script
- **Event types/details of fields:** @manos-saratsis where do we get this info?
- If we are completely blocked it makes no sense to retry/try storing informations anywhere IMHO Therefore we try sending and ignore the result.

review_comments: There is an off-by-one error, loop should start on `ACLK_LWS_CALLBACK_HISTORY-1`

This is not always called. When I messed the password (after the challenge) the connection was not established.

Why does it expect to have this `websocket_connection_up == 0` when the code that sets this to 0 is L467

We want report to be sent only if WSI_DESTROY is called when there was not successful connection yet.
Idea is to report when ACLK link could not be established.
Point of this is to have an idea in how many cases ACLK cannot connect (e.g. by blocked firewall).

we are diagnosing if connection to the cloud was possible (not blocked by firewall) as soon as connection is established we know that is OK and we don't have to report anything.
It doesn't try to diagnose the MQTT failures that might happen after.

Why not use the state of `aclk_connected`? This is the high-level flag that the link was established correctly. Your logic that any WSI_DESTROY before success is a form of failure would apply better to this flag.
that is too late... we do not care about MQTT here. If connection TLS upgrade and then upgrade to Websockets succeeds then connection succeeded (proxy or firewall didn't block us)
Yes we do - that is the whole point.
